name: Juro contracts
description:
For any business user who needs to work with contracts or their data, Juro’s MCP server enables you to access contract intelligence directly from Claude. 

Search for contracts and their content, get analysis and reports, edit, download and upload document versions - all without leaving Claude.

Bring the power of the world’s leading frontier AI lab into your contract repository - and let your business colleagues work in their AI platform of choice. Connect Juro’s MCP server with Claude to agree contracts faster today.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Juro contracts to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Juro contracts to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://integrations.app.juro.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Juro contracts MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Juro contracts provides these MCP tools: download-document, fetch, graphql-search, request-upload-url, and upload-document-version.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Juro contracts?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Juro contracts in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Juro contracts MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Juro contracts requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Juro contracts is developed by Juro. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
